verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a generic developer-portal line saying Drata can 'automate questionnaires' programmatically. Nothing documents importing SIG, CAIQ, portal or spreadsheet questionnaires, or exporting answers back in the customer's original format. General questionnaire automation is an adjacent capability, not the format-faithful import and export this story requires, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a sales lead, questionnaires arrive in every shape — SIG, CAIQ, portals, spreadsheets — and the platform imports and exports them in the format the customer sent

citations.quote: Automate questionnaires and manage your trust center programmatically.
